prompt.project_info: Create a candid high-angle afternoon selfie of an approved adult woman resting on a knitted blanket.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark-brown wavy hair spread around her head, light-to-medium warm skin, calm neutral expression, rings and dark manicure, wearing an opaque dark-grey long-sleeve top and dark lounge bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle 2:3 smartphone selfie, face and upper torso in close-up, lying comfortably on a creamy-white knitted blanket, wooden floorboards and a small blue shoe visible at the edge, diagonal composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm diffused ambient light from upper right, gentle undefined shadows, creamy neutral palette and relaxed casual mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic wide-angle smartphone camera, sharp face and hair, natural texture, soft background focus, realistic medium-resolution detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A candid high-angle 2:3 smartphone selfie of an approved adult woman with long dark-brown wavy hair spread around her head and shoulders, warm light-to-medium skin, and a calm neutral expression. She wears an opaque dark-grey long-sleeve top and dark lounge bottoms, lying comfortably on a thick creamy-white knitted blanket or rug while holding the phone with her right hand. Wooden floorboards and a small portion of a blue shoe appear at the edge. Use warm diffused ambient light from the upper right, gentle undefined shadows, creamy-white and dark-brown palette, sharp face and hair, natural texture, and relaxed casual composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, spaghetti straps, exposed midriff, lingerie, sultry pose, body emphasis, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, blanket, floor, hair, dark palette, light, and comfortable resting pose; replace wardrobe with equally opaque lounge clothing. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced crop/spaghetti-strap styling and slightly sultry wording with opaque lounge clothing and a comfortable resting pose.
